name: Decius
biography: works in the computer security industry. His job consists mostly of having meetings with people and filling out forms. He used to do a lot of patch reversing but he doesn't have time any more. He has spoken at Blackhat Federal, Electronic Frontier Forums, H.O.P.E., Summercon, Phreaknic, Interz0ne, and Outerz0ne. He likes beer, particularly if it is from Bavaria.
